item: W4 rqls_assay_v1 (numpy float feasibility assay; NOT a certificate)

stop_registry.relevant: S-OLD-1 (old float probe: DISK_FLOOR, weak G8 control) is NOT resumed; this is new code with new controls. No other relevant stop.

inputs.note: old lane control C1 (Zhang-Cao Example 2.4); regular-file read-only; hash re-checked inside the script; old README pin da95d092...

processes: one python process, no children, single-threaded BLAS
absolute_child_end: launch + 1800 s (self budget 1700 s; longest uninterruptible step estimated <= 30 s: one 3000x2000 SVD); then 120 s settlement + 60 s margin

resources.output_enforcement: JSONL hard byte cap 8 MiB inside the writer (records beyond cap counted, not written); stdout empty by design; stderr only interpreter warnings/traceback (bounded; guard below)

inflight_guard: worker samples RSS (ps -o rss), output file sizes and df free at least every 300 s; owned identity-checked SIGTERM (PID+PGID+argv hash+cwd) if RSS > 2 GiB, output > 10 MiB, free < 12.2e9, or wall > 1900 s; bounded wait; no SIGKILL

stages.A: exact anchors for the float verifier: A1 Example 2.4 (expect maxdev<1e-12, rays=64), A2 phase mutation (expect maxdev>0.1), A3/A4 classical Parker pair in classical-U, forced-U and unsymmetric encodings (expect maxdev<1e-12, rays=10, F~0)
stages.L: local analysis at 300 classical forced-U points (5 classical pairs x 2 resolution choices x 30 label triples (0,a,b)): exact Jacobian kernel minus rank of gauge+representative-phase tangents = excess; Gauss-Newton continuation along excess directions (<=12 steps, step 0.04 halving to 0.0025) recording distinct rays; plus the unsymmetric kernel count at one classical point
stages.C1: v=6 Cay(Z_6), 4 random starts: no 1-RQLS(6) exists [IMPORT Ball-Simoens via Zhang-Cao] -> any verified solution is a defect
stages.C2: v=5 Cay(Z_5), 6 starts: every 1-RQLS(5) is classical [IMPORT] -> any verified solution with rays != 5 is a defect
stages.C3_C4: calibration v=7 Cay(Z_7) and v=8 XOR (maximal solutions known to exist) - record convergence and ray distribution
stages.C5_C6_C7: symmetric-path calibration: Z_7+0 (Cay(Z_7) isotope), Z_7+1 at v=8 from F_8 (classical solutions exist), Z_7+3 classical Parker B with classical U (classical solutions exist)
stages.T1: Z_7+3 forced form, random B-data/corner/labels, 2 starts x 6000 iterations per configuration
stages.T1c: Z_7+3 forced form started at classical Parker points + noise 0.15
stages.T2: Z_9+1 random B-data, eigen label m* random
stages.T3: Z_5+5 random bijections, corner L and labels M linear orthogonal pair
stages.T4: unsymmetric v=10: Parker B, Cay(D_5), Cay(Z_10), 2 starts x 20000 iterations

pass_fail_controls: A1, A2, A3, A4, C1, C2 are pass/fail; a failure latches STOP on this item and invalidates every result of the run. C3-C7 are calibrations only.
candidate_rule: maximal candidate = verified maxdev<1e-8, all v^2 rays distinct (merge threshold 1-|<q,q'>|^2<1e-7) and min separation >1e-6. A v=10 candidate is a NUMERICAL LEAD only: notify parent immediately, then freeze, high-precision polish (mpmath, needs its own GO), exact recognition, exact checker, independent checker, reviews.
scientific_consequence: Misses are UNKNOWN for the sampled configurations and say nothing about the target. Kernel counts are numerical single-kernel statements about the local structure at the named classical points; they are not proofs.
settlement: settled = direct child exit reaped, no descendants, JSONL closed and hashed, receipt written. Otherwise UNSETTLED.
